_comment: NOT implemented, and removed rather than left as a crash. 'When this hits, at the beginning of your end phase, put the top card of your deck face up into your arsenal' was authored as PUT_TOP_DECK_BOTTOM with zone=arsenal -- a type that does not exist, and whose name says the BOTTOM OF THE DECK, the opposite destination. Being nested inside an INJECT_TRIGGER it compiled lazily, so it raised ValueError at the end phase of any turn this hit. There is no deck-to-arsenal effect to express it with yet; PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM moves the other way.
